ID0443737.
Here are the reported faults:
PowerConverter[6]
Missing Converters in DC2
LockRelease_CA1_AC_Charging: Unlock voltage was not present
Could you please re-run the diagnostics for power module no. 6
and for the LockRelease_CA1_AC_Charging error, which was not
mentioned in the previous intervention report?
I am attaching screenshots from the SCB.

The first issue concerns the converter. Please go on site to troubleshoot the problem. If the issue persists after exchanging the two converters and the serial number (SN) remains the same, then the problem is with the converter and it needs to be replaced. However, if the SN changes, the issue is likely with the cable.
Regarding the issue with CA1, please check if 12VDC is reaching CA1. Then verify if KF3 is correctly passing 12VDC to IN+ and IN-, and subsequently to OUT+ and OUT-. If everything is working fine, please check on XD23 whether 12VDC is applied to pins 37 and 35. If the motor is functioning properly, ensure that the feedback signal is being sent to KF8 via XD38 pins 21 and 18.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.

unified service process
.

afonso-sousa@siemens.com

.

Thank you.
